## Error handler
Every failing workflow calls this one (set it in each workflow: Settings > Error workflow).
Python classifies the error, picks severity, writes cause + troubleshooting steps + business impact, then: email, log to sheet 'ErrorLog' (Timestamp | Workflow | Node | Severity | Category | Message | ExecutionURL | ExecutionId), optional Telegram.
Edit the To/From email in 'Alert Settings'.
